intro:
⚠️ BEFORE STEP 1 — check you are in a test copy. Look for the small “🧪 Test copy” mark on the screen. It means this app has never seen you, which is what the steps below expect. If it is missing and the app already shows your own information, you have opened your real app: go back to your list and tap this app's name again, rather than using a bookmark, your history, or an icon on your home screen. Starting in the wrong copy makes the early steps look broken when nothing is wrong.

The Daraja front door lists all the apps on shelves. You will pick your shelf, give your name, open three apps right inside the front door and come back each time, and check it remembers you. A short setup may be offered after the welcome tour, four questions you answer by tapping. Unless a step tells you to try it, tap “No thanks, just open it”.

steps.do: The page says “Daraja — your family of apps, one front door” and asks which shelf is yours. Tap “🏠 Your household”.
steps.see: A small box asks “And what should I call you?” with a place to type, Cancel and OK.

steps.do: Type this name (keep the apostrophe) and tap “OK”.
steps.see: A green card greets you by name — “…, Margaret O'Brien. Your shelf is ready.” — and says “The green ones are the ones you already use.” Below it, “☀️ What would you like to do?” has six big tiles, like “🍽 Plan a meal” and “🙋 Ask the family something”.

steps.do: Scroll down to the “🏠 Your household” shelf.
steps.see: App cards including 🌱 Every Day, 🍽 Our Table, 🙋 Who’s Coming, 🧾 Ahead of It and 🔑 The Key, each saying “free”. A few cards (for example 🫙 Jar by Jar and 📊 Family Money Dashboard) say “Coming soon”: that is right, they are not in the store yet. No card names a price. 🧭 One Thing is not on this shelf: it is on the “Your day” shelf.
Every Day opens right inside the page, with a dark strip across the top: “‹ Daraja”, “🌱 Every Day” and “open on its own ↗”. Every Day’s own welcome card shows.
steps.tip: Don’t do the Every Day tour now — we are only checking that it opens.

steps.do: Tap “‹ Daraja” in the top-left corner.
steps.see: You are back at the front door. The green card now says “Every Day: 6 cards left” and has a “Turn a card” button.

steps.do: Scroll down to the “🏠 Your household” shelf again.
steps.see: The Every Day card now says “you use this”; Our Table still says “try it · free while testing”.

steps.do: Scroll back up and tap the “🍽 Plan a meal” tile.
steps.see: Our Table opens inside the page; the dark strip at the top says “🍽 Our Table”.
Back at the front door, with the “☀️ What would you like to do?” tiles.

steps.do: Tap the “🙋 Ask the family something” tile.
steps.see: Who’s Coming opens inside the page; the strip at the top says “🙋 Who’s Coming”.
Back at the front door again.

steps.do: At the top, in the green card, tap “Turn a card”.
steps.see: Every Day opens inside the page again (“🌱 Every Day” in the top strip).

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The front door opens with the green card still greeting Margaret O'Brien. It does not ask your name again.

steps.do: Scroll down to the “🏠 Your household” shelf.
steps.see: Every Day, Our Table and Who’s Coming all say “you use this” and sit at the front of the shelf. The front door remembers what you opened today.

steps.do: Scroll up a little and tap “Your day” in the row of shelf buttons.
steps.see: The “Your day” shelf shows 🧭 One Thing and 📣 Message Assistant, each saying “free”.

steps.do: Now the videos. This app has 3. Open each one and watch it right through, sound on: Explain it to me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=home&mode=firsttime  Watch it work — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=home  Train me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=home&mode=train
steps.see: Each one talks without stopping — no long silences, no sentence starting again. The screen behind the words changes to match what is being said, and when it points at something, that thing is really there. If a video talks about a button or a screen you did not see in this app, say so — that is a real fault and one of the most useful things you can find.

steps.do: Last, the shop page everyone sees before they buy: https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/ — find this app on its shelf and read its card.
steps.see: The name and the one-line description match the app you just used. The price says Free, with an optional donation to Loving InDeed. That is right: nothing is sold, and nobody has to give. Nothing on the card promises something the app does not do. If the card and the app disagree, the card is the fault — say which bit.

steps.do: Tap into any box where you type (a name, a note, a to-do). Look beside the box for a small round 🎤 pop-up. Then tap the 🎤 on your phone’s keyboard and say a few words. Do it three times in a row. If this app has no box to type in, skip this step and say so.
steps.see: No floating round 🎤 button sits beside the box, and the keyboard’s 🎤 writes your words all three times, not just the first or second. A few apps have their own 🎤 button built into the screen (Feedback Studio, Rafiki, One Thing, Business Manager, In My Own Words). That is meant to be there. A fault is a floating 🎤 beside a box, or the keyboard 🎤 stopping after one or two tries. If it stops, tell us which time, and your phone (iPhone or Android).
